description: Per-variation weapon loadout rows: parallel arrays of weapon IDs, attachment socket names and initial visibility flags used by battles, level sequences and UI captures.

ID.simple: Row key referenced by CharacterVariation::Id_CharacterWeapon (typically a variation ID).
ID.technical: FName primary key (ImportKeyField=Id in the export), e.g. CP_040_00. Battle preload, BattleBase, LevelSequencer and capture resolve the current variation's Id_CharacterWeapon against CharacterWeaponDataTables (DTM +0x4E0); None skips weapon spawning.

Id_Weapon.simple: Array of WeaponDataTable IDs to spawn for this loadout.
Id_Weapon.technical: TArray<FName>, four slots in the export. Each non-None ID is resolved to a Weapon row (DTM +0x6B0); its FileName_BP is turned into a Weapon-primary loader/preload entry and the loaded class is spawned via AGameCharacter::SpawnWeapon. Battle preload collects all weapon Blueprints; BattleBase/LevelSequencer/capture spawn the actors. None entries are skipped.

SocketName.simple: Socket/bone name on the character mesh where each weapon attaches.
SocketName.technical: TArray<FName> parallel to Id_Weapon, e.g. R_Weapon or L_Weapon. BattleBase and LevelSequencer pass SocketName[WeaponIndex] directly to SpawnWeapon. The capture actor uses the same value but falls back to FName('root') when the parallel slot is missing and, for non-SituationOverview captures with weapon idle montages configured, overrides the socket to 'root'. BattleBase reads the array by index without a validity check.

bDefaultHidden.simple: Whether each weapon starts inactive/hidden after spawning.
bDefaultHidden.technical: TArray<bool> parallel to Id_Weapon. BattleBase calls Weapon->SetActive(bDefaultHidden[Index] == false) after spawning, so true means hidden/inactive and false means active. The capture actor uses the same flag with a false fallback when the parallel slot is missing, then may hide weapons not present in a SituationOverview pose or show pose-only weapons. All exported slots are false in the available rows.

notes: Export contains 15 rows, each with four parallel Id_Weapon / SocketName / bDefaultHidden slots; typically only the first slot is populated.

The three arrays are index-aligned; most consumers iterate Id_Weapon.Num() and index the other arrays directly (capture has IsValidIndex fallbacks for socket/hidden). None in Id_Weapon means the slot is unused.
CharacterWeaponDataTable is distinct from WeaponDataTable: this table selects and places weapons for a variation, while WeaponDataTable supplies each weapon's FileName_BP asset name.
Single table asset 'CharacterWeaponDataTable' loaded into DTM +0x4E0; no numbered shards or localization variants in the export.
Reconstructed source with cited retail RVAs; no claim about Blueprint-only consumers or byte-identical matching.

usages.detail: Collects weapon Blueprints for this variation into battle preload lists.
Spawns weapons at the specified sockets and applies the default-hidden active state.
Sequence setup spawns weapons with the same loadout and sockets.
Capture loading merges character weapon slots with SituationOverview pose weapons.
